publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
vintage: 2025 Housing Inventory Count (count night in January 2025)
table: 2025 HIC Counts by State, project-level CSV: Year-Round Beds and Pit Count of emergency shelter (ES), transitional housing (TH) and safe haven (SH) projects, current and under-development inventory, summed by the project's city
title: Year-round shelter beds by state and city, HUD 2025 Housing Inventory Count
universe: Year-round beds in ES, TH and SH projects on the count night (permanent and rapid rehousing beds left out)
geography: State (CocState) and the project's address city; geocodes are HUD's six-digit CoC geography codes (state FIPS + CDBG jurisdiction, 9 + county FIPS for a county's remainder)
limits: Cities are the project's mailing city as HUD lists it, not a census place; a builder joining them to the game's places needs a name match within the state or the geocode's county. Victim service providers' addresses are withheld, so their beds have no city (bedsWithoutCity). Beds counted in a city may serve people from the whole Continuum of Care. Under-development inventory is included, as in HUD's state totals.
